api.declaration: JSONFieldOf(func(*P)*V) resolves the json tag once, shares runtime JSON promotion/validation and model offset uniqueness checks. Validate at startup; invalid and zero descriptors fail closed when used. Fixed arrays bind an element selector; maps/slices constrain element and key types in their signatures.
api.state: Direct method-free rowData and invariant owner/payload markers; no embedding chains, new Query/Table/column methods or capability bridges.
api.semantics: Missing and SQL-null ancestors yield SQL NULL, while present JSON null remains present in JSON/Kind. Scalar extraction maps both missing and JSON null to SQL NULL. Safe Length is SQL NULL for every non-array kind. Runtime map keys/indexes are bound; declared property names are safe literals. Optional/Nullable/pointer/nested JSON wrappers unwrap explicitly; exact payload codec required for scalar extraction.

footprint.justification: The path consumer exercises optional properties, nested payloads, a quoted int field, a typed map key, text and numeric extraction, typed predicate construction, mapping and decoding over six JSON columns. JSON codec/result instantiations across these payload shapes account for the larger new probe; all work is opt-in and every existing probe has zero function growth. The functions consumer separately measures Kind, Length, nullable containment and mapping. Ceilings are ceil(final measured * 1.15); no accepted ceiling changed.

coverage.runtime: Startup pointer/tag binding, promoted embedded-value fields, foreign/ignored/opaque/zero-sized fields, nil selectors, panic/Goexit containment, zero declarations, invalid keys/codecs/kinds, declaration ownership, Param error propagation, fragment snapshots and JSON-null decoding.
coverage.parity: Whole-document Kind/containment/contained-by (row/selected, required/nullable); Length, optional fields, quoted numeric/string fields, canonical integer and string map keys, negative slice/fixed-array indices, JSON null vs missing/SQL NULL, Exists/IsMissing/IsJSONNull and path fragment containment. Existing 6d1/6d2 and 6a golden results retained.
coverage.postgres: Source covers actual JSON shape/null semantics, safe length on all six kinds, typed map/index/scalar extraction, existence/containment predicates and transaction participation. Compile and vet only; lead runs PostgreSQL.
